title: Cr-Ni uncertainty-analysis example: data and scripts
description: Processed results and plotting scripts for the Cr-Ni computational example of the chapter 'Beyond Quantification: Propagating and Exploiting CALPHAD Uncertainty in Materials Design' (Uncertainty Quantification in Multiscale Materials Modeling, 2nd ed., Elsevier). Includes the sampled parameter vectors, the independently recombined and local Gaussian ensembles, FCC-frequency maps, phase-boundary percentiles, sampling diagnostics and the ranking of 30 candidate measurements.
